instruction: Perform as a young man who is easily frightened and constantly on edge. His voice is on the higher side, and he speaks in bursts of anxious energy, sometimes whining or shouting in panic. Even when talking about something simple, his delivery is filled with over-the-top emotion and volatility.
text: So I was just minding my own business, you know, just walking into the kitchen to get a glass of water, and then I saw it. It was huge! Absolutely massive, with at least a dozen legs, probably more! I'm not even kidding! I froze, I couldn't move, I couldn't even scream! My life was flashing before my eyes, right there, next to the toaster!
